blurb: By Frederick Knott. Adapted by Jeffrey Hatcher A thriller based on the popular movie of the same name. A young blind housewife discovers she is being conned by three gangsters, including a heartless killer named Roat. The movie had an all-star cast including Audrey Hepburn and Alan Arkin.
